name: central-hub-coding-tracker
description: Records active coding time from Cursor and VS Code into Sentral Hub.

centralHub.supabaseUrl.description: Supabase project URL (the same value as VITE_SUPABASE_URL). The anon key is public; the password is never stored.

centralHub.supabaseAnonKey.description: Supabase anon key (the same value as VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY). This is the public API key, not the service role key.

centralHub.heartbeatSeconds.description: How many active seconds one stored heartbeat covers.

centralHub.idleSeconds.description: Stop counting when the editor has been quiet for this many seconds.
